title: Golden cross, long or flat
author: arhancanli
rationale: Prices trend more than a random walk allows at multi-month horizons, so a fast average above a slow one tends to mark an uptrend. Holding only in uptrends is meant to avoid the worst of long falls.
risks: Whipsaws in sideways markets, and late exits around turning points. It sits out sharp rebounds until the averages cross again.
references: Brock, Lakonishok and LeBaron (1992), Simple Technical Trading Rules and the Stochastic Properties of Stock Returns, Journal of Finance
